classifications.label: H1: No real correlation – the observed agreements are consistent with random chance.
H2: Genuine physical coupling – a shared environmental factor or unknown interaction links pendulum and resonator readings at certain lags.
H3: Systematic measurement artefact – a shared timing or data‑recording bias creates spurious lagged correlations.
H4: Non‑physical generation – the recorded values are being produced or altered by an external process (e.g., algorithmic replay or deliberate editing) rather than reflecting natural measurements.
